review_type: purposive systematic-style historical evidence map and framework stress test

search.search_log_type: normalized reconstruction from retained run context
search.raw_query_limitation: The tool context was compacted before final artifact assembly; every exact raw query string was not recoverable. The search log therefore labels reconstructed normalized queries rather than falsely representing them as byte-exact raw tool calls.
search.result_count_reason: No reproducible exported result counts were retained; counts are intentionally not invented.

model_execution.role_execution: sequential isolated reasoning/search passes within one model environment

saturation.description: After challenge cases spanning spectra, residual groups, revised classifications and context-constrained populations, no additional universal criterion was identified beyond U08/U09 and structural/context amendments. The run does not claim exhaustive historical saturation and did not use a formal multi-cycle no-new-reference stopping count.

telemetry.reason_null: These metrics were not exposed reliably by the current execution environment and are not estimated.

integrity_notes: Classification events are historical comparators, not independent epidemiological effect estimates.
Nested cases such as Burkitt lymphoma discovery and later Burkitt subtype revision are intentionally separate classification events, not counted as independent biological replications.
Contemporary entities such as MOGAD, ANCA-based vasculitis classification and type 5 diabetes are explicitly labeled evolving or contested where appropriate.
Socioeconomic and political context is used to modify inference about discovery opportunity and adoption timing, not as positive evidence of biological disease separation.
No exact search-result counts, token counts, cost estimates or causal percentages for science-versus-context were invented.
